verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair axis for a developer framework, so it applies. The pack shows released package versions (livekit-agents 1.8.0, lk 2.18.6) and deployment rollback, but neither is a versioned-API scheme with a documented deprecation policy. No evidence describes API versioning guarantees, deprecation timelines, or migration policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
